_assumption: Built from Paystack's documented refund fields (settlement, deducted_amount, fully_deducted, dispute, transaction); not recorded from a live account. M4b assumes a refund taken out of a payout names that settlement, with the amount in deducted_amount, and that a dispute the payer won (a lost dispute) is deducted the same way, as a refund with `dispute` set: Paystack does not document how chargebacks appear in settlements (OQ-01). This refund is of a charge paid before the settlement.
